if {(($c >> 24) == -128) && ([format %x $a] eq {80000000} || [format %x $a] eq {ffffffff80000000})} { set start [expr {$end - 16 - $b - $off}] } else { close $fd ; return {-} }
seek $fd $start ; set e [read $fd 2] ; if {![string equal $e JL] && ![string equal $e JL]} { close $fd ; return {-} }
